note: 기계 판독용 단일 진실 원천. HANDOFF.md/README.md는 참고용이며 충돌 시 이 파일이 우선한다. 값은 KRW 정수.

project.name: gamtan-settle
project.purpose: 크린토피아/홈클린마스터 일정(구글 캘린더) → 대표(킴)와 김한준님 정산액 자동 계산 웹페이지

stack.calendar: google calendar api via service account (JWT RS256); fallback ICAL_URL

project.access: public url, X-Robots-Tag noindex, no auth
project.last_known_good_deployment: dpl_DjvZDpTiEQFRvAgvNxAyHVpQvqMK (deployed from equivalent source; byte equality with this folder was not verified)

required.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON
required.format: entire service-account key JSON as one env value (needs client_email, private_key)

steps.action: create GitHub repo; push contents of this folder as repo root
steps.expect: repo root contains api/, public/, package.json, vercel.json, verify.js, fixtures.json, handoff.json

steps.action: run local verification before anything else
steps.expect: exit code 0 and last line `TOTAL pass=41 fail=0`

steps.action: create a Redis database; provide REDIS_URL to the deploy environment
google cloud: enable Calendar API; create service account + JSON key; share the target calendar with the service-account email with permission 'See all event details' (free/busy only is NOT enough)
create vercel project (name free), set env REDIS_URL, GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID for Production; deploy the WHOLE folder
rules: deploy all files in one request; never a partial file set to production (a partial deploy blanks the live alias)
vercel mcp create_deployment: pass name/project/target=production and the full file list; do not pass teamId/slug unless required (explicit team id returned 403 on the previous account)
wait for state READY via get_deployment

steps.action: check Deployment Protection: unauthenticated GET / must return 200
steps.on_failure: if GET / is 401/403: Vercel Authentication / Deployment Protection is on -> ask owner to turn it off for production (owner decision: the page is intentionally public)

steps.expect: exit code 0; every live:* fixture PASS
steps.note: the check 'deployed index.html differs from repo' passes only when deployed bytes equal public/index.html; deploy from this repo so it passes

steps.action: report to owner: URL, verify output summary (pass/fail counts), any FAIL lines verbatim

verification.fixtures: fixtures.json (28 rows: 19 real jobs + 9 synthetic rule probes; 3 week sums)
verification.how_it_works: verify.js slices DEF, parse(), isSolo and calc() out of public/index.html as text and executes them (no duplicated logic), feeds memo_lines through api/events.js helpers (extraOf, crewOf, hanOf, settleOf), then compares recv, han, mine, baseAmt, exAmt, parkAmt, warn.
verification.live_scope: live check uses calendar events returned by /api/events and ignores per-job overrides stored via /api/state

triage.live:<id> event not found: calendar not shared with service account, wrong GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID, or event title/date edited
triage.live:<id> recv/han mismatch but local pa: calendar memo changed (compare memo parsers) or fixture is stale; do not edit fixtures to match without owner confirmation
triage.GET /api/events 502: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON invalid or Calendar API disabled or calendar not shared
triage.deployed index.html differs: deployed from a different file set; redeploy from repo root

after_every_code_change: update fixtures.json only for owner-approved rule changes

functions.extraOf: const extraOf = d => { const m = (d || "").match(/추가금\s*[:：]\s*([\d,]+)/); return m ? +m[1].replace(/,/g, "") : 0; };
functions.crewOf: const crewOf = d => { const m = (d || "").match(/작업인원\s*[:：]\s*(\d)\s*명/); return m ? +m[1] : 0; };

fields.hanCal: 한준님 ... N원 -> TOTAL amount paid to 김한준님 for that job, extra share already included
fields.settleExtra: + 추가 N원 -> already-settled extra (do NOT multiply by 0.75)

memo_parsers.privacy_invariant: API returns only the 6 numeric fields + id,summary,start,end. memo text (phones, door codes) must never be returned.

title_rules.ampm: title contains (오전)|(오후) else start hour<13 => 오전
title_rules.ignored_titles: anything without the tags (e.g. reminder events starting with a phone emoji)

crin.ext: crinExternal(70000) if 27<=py<=39 and crew!=2 else 0 (crew from state.crew or crewCal; unset counts as 3)
crin.extra: if extraCal>0: extraCal*crinExtraRate(0.75); elif settleExtra>0 and no extraCal: settleExtra as-is; else 0
crin.han: hanBase(70000) + extra*hanCrinExtraShare(0.5); if 27<=py<=39 and crew==2: + hanCrinTwo(35000)
crin.py_gt_39: warn=true (4-person special case); amounts still computed, owner must override

own.note: settleBase is ignored for own; only settleExtra is used as extra when extraCal==0
own.extra: extra*ownExtraRate(1.0) to recv; han += extra*hanOwnExtraShare(0.5) except py<=13 and alone => han share 0

common.parking: settlePark added to recv only, never split (all to 킴)
common.hanCal_override: if hanCal>0: han = hanCal (total, replaces computed han incl. extra share)
override_order: state.recvOverride (recv=value; baseAmt=value; exAmt=0; parkAmt=0; warn cleared)
common.counted_in_totals: job end time <= now AND not cancel AND not state.exclude
common.pay_day: week Monday + 10 days (Thursday of next week)

month_box: 이번 달 킴 정산액 (정산총액 − 김한준님 지급액)
display_rules.calendar: month grid, 7 columns Mon..Sun, each day: 오전 half on top, 오후 half below; day footer shows 킴 and 김한준님 in 만원 (1 decimal)
display_rules.job_detail: recv with 기본+추가금(+주차비); 김한준님 with 기본+추가금 share; 킴 with 기본+추가금(+주차비); breakdown rows hidden when no extra and no parking
display_rules.py_ge_40: card prefix '! ', detail tag '40평↑ 4인 확인', top chip '40평 이상 N건 · 4인 작업 확인'

api.polling: page refreshes every 60s and on tab visible

data_migration.from_old_redis: copy keys settle:jobs (hash) and settle:settings (string); skipping them loses only per-job manual overrides and edited rates, not memo-derived amounts

invariants: never return calendar description text from api/events.js
never deploy a partial file set to production
do not change a rule or fixture without owner confirmation
amounts are integers in KRW; display uses toLocaleString(ko-KR)+원
verify.js must exit 0 before and after every deployment
known_limits: price rules for py>=40 are not automated
crin 27..39 without 작업인원 memo is treated as 3 crew (no +35000)
hanCal is a total, not a base
no concurrent-edit handling in state storage

owner_preferences.style: facts and numbers only, concise, no ethical/emotional commentary
owner_preferences.money_format: KRW with thousands separators; owner also speaks in 만원
owner_preferences.show_calculation: always show how an amount was derived (base + extra, 75%/100%, 5:5)
owner_preferences.after_deploy: confirm READY then tell owner to refresh

first_prompt_for_new_claude: Read handoff.json completely, then run `node verify.js` in the repo root and report the last line. Then execute steps[] in order. Do not change rules, fixtures or labels. After deployment run `node verify.js --url <production-url>` and report pass/fail counts and any FAIL lines verbatim.
